projectRule: Project WORLD_CANON wins conflicts. Sublevels never replace integer parent level.number; Level 6 parent remains the project outdoor dark-tundra baseline. Entity roaming is a separate Project override and is never disabled by a Wiki entity-count or resident-entity classification, including Levels 0, 4 and 6.

difficultyPolicy.rule: Use the current Backrooms Fandom Threat/Survivability Index directly when a standard class is verified. Non-standard or missing classes keep the raw Wiki class when known and receive an explicit Project gameplay rating. PROJECT_DESIGNED values are provisional and never presented as Wiki canon.
difficultyPolicy.roamingEntityOverride: All canonical runtime Entities remain eligible to roam every parent Level 0-6 and every listed sublevel; difficulty metadata must not become a spawn allowlist.

difficulty.rationale: Current source crawl exposes the Level 0 environment but no reliable current Threat Index header; rating 2 is a provisional gameplay value for disorientation, resource scarcity and isolation.
Current Backrooms Fandom Class 1 category includes Level 1.
Current Backrooms Fandom Class 2 category includes Level 2.
Current Backrooms Fandom Class 2 category includes Level 3; the page is under rewrite, so the class is kept as the current reference.
Current Backrooms Fandom Class Habitable category includes Level 4; gameplay maps Habitable to rating 1 while Project-wide roaming remains enabled.
Current Backrooms Fandom Class 5 category includes Level 5.
Current Backrooms Fandom Threat Index is Class Undetermined with exits 4/5 and environment 3/5; gameplay uses a cautious rating 4 while preserving the raw class.

records.name: Incessant Hum-Buzz
records.summary: A Level 0 offshoot with familiar yellow walls, beige carpet and fluorescent hum, but much larger rooms, multi-level terrain, tunnels, raised platforms and frequent structural anomalies.

difficulty.rationale: No reliable current Threat Index was exposed in the verified page; rating 3 reflects frequent structural anomalies, multi-level terrain and the intensified hum-buzz hazard.

records.name: The Exit ?
records.summary: A seemingly endless labyrinth of long dull-yellow hallways with moist carpet and spaced fluorescent lights. Isolation is extreme and the environment becomes increasingly unstable deeper inside.

difficulty.rationale: Current Threat Index is Class 2: exit 4/5, environment 3/5, entities 0/5.

records.name: Deep Emptiness
records.summary: A very long hallway system whose doorways usually open into empty Level-0-like rooms; some rooms may contain crates, shelves and limited supplies. The wiki page is currently being rewritten, so fine details are reference-only.

difficulty.rationale: Current Backrooms Fandom Class 5 category includes Level 0.1; the page is still under rewrite.

records.name: Water Damage
records.summary: A flooded non-Euclidean complex of concrete rooms and corridors with rotting carpet, inconsistent fluorescent lighting, dripping water, pipes and a layout that shifts enough to disorient travelers.

difficulty.rationale: The current English page details flooding, decay and shifting geometry but a current Threat Index was not reliably exposed; rating 3 is provisional.

records.name: Fully Remodeled
records.summary: An empty remodeled industrial variation of Level 0 with yellow-green or brown walls, patterned gray carpet, vents, heaters, modern doors and salvageable construction equipment; it retains non-Euclidean behavior.

difficulty.rationale: No reliable current Threat Index was exposed in the verified page; rating 2 reflects a comparatively navigable but still non-Euclidean industrial environment.

records.name: Half Finished
records.summary: Factory-like office spaces that look partially under construction and are affected by an isolation phenomenon. The wiki page is explicitly marked for rewrite, so only the broad visual premise is treated as stable reference.

difficulty.rationale: Current Threat Index is Class 3: exit 2/5, environment 3/5, entities 4/5.

records.name: Disease
records.summary: A decayed retail-backroom environment with dark yellow-green damaged walls, moldy wet carpet, exposed concrete and a time-frozen feeling; tears into darkness and the rare 'Pause' phenomenon make traversal hazardous.

difficulty.rationale: Current Threat Index is Class 4: exit 3/5, environment 4/5, entities 4/5.

records.name: Chaotic Structure
records.summary: An infinite field of randomly spliced solid forms and cubes with wildly varying scales, producing chaotic geometry rather than ordinary connected rooms.

difficulty.rationale: A current Threat Index was not reliably exposed from the canonical page; rating 3 reflects chaotic gravity/geometry, restricted visibility and navigation uncertainty.

records.name: The Lobby Went COLD
records.summary: A deep-blue, extremely cold Level-0-like environment whose walls can shift and reorient unpredictably. The average temperature reported by the wiki is around -89°C and usable resources are effectively absent.

difficulty.rationale: Current Backrooms Fandom Class 5 category includes Level 0.66; extreme cold and unstable geometry support the classification.

records.name: Claustrophobia
records.summary: A darker, dirtier and narrower Level-0-like maze with mostly nonfunctional lights, tall walls, mold and long tight hallways. Unlike Level 0, group travel is possible and small amounts of useful objects may appear.

difficulty.rationale: The current page did not expose a reliable current Threat Index in this verification pass; rating 4 reflects darkness, constricted navigation, mold and severe route risk.

records.name: Inundation
records.summary: A flooded Level 0 offshoot with cold water, hot humid air, mold, missing ceiling sections and broad dark zones. Its layout lacks Level 0's usual non-Euclidean effect, and other wanderers or adapted hostile life can be encountered.

difficulty.rationale: Current Threat Index is Class 3: exit 3/5, environment 3/5, entities 3/5.

records.name: Deeper Regions
records.summary: An extremely unstable corrupted variation of Level 0 with scrambled, differently scaled geometry, louder fluorescent hum, six increasingly deep segments, isolation, and almost no useful objects.

difficulty.rationale: Current Threat Index is Class 5: exit 5/5, environment 5/5, entities 0/5.

records.name: The Basement of Level 1
records.summary: An infinite basement/bunker network beneath Level 1 with dusty corridors, broken boiler rooms, empty food-storage rooms and rare Almond Water puddles. Spores and Molded-related hazards make respiratory protection important.

difficulty.rationale: Current Threat Index is Class 2: exit 1/5, environment 4/5, entities 2/5.

records.name: Fallen Vehicle
records.summary: A large enclosed parking-like region associated with Level 1, characterized by broad concrete surfaces, aged parking markings and a more exposed garage layout. The current wiki entry is under rewrite, so specifics remain reference-only.

difficulty.rationale: Current Threat Index is Class 4: environment 4/5, exit 3/5, entities 4/5.

records.name: Lurking Danger
records.summary: A variable warehouse/office/unfinished-concrete environment with lit and pitch-black sections; carried lights do not function inside the dark zones. Large rooms can contain dirt and grass, and prolonged silence creates severe psychological pressure.

difficulty.rationale: Current Threat Index is Class 2: exit 3/5, environment 4/5, entities 0/5.

records.name: Midas’ Touch
records.summary: A gold-toned warehouse labyrinth with warm wall pipes, oddly placed windows filled by intense white light, offices and storage rooms. Its defining anomaly is a gradual conversion of living matter toward gold.

difficulty.rationale: No reliable current Threat Index was verified from the canonical page; rating 4 reflects progressive body-altering gold conversion and difficult labyrinth navigation.

records.name: The Subterranean Complex
records.summary: A hot underground network of concrete-brick tunnels and natural-looking caves with dim lights, exposed construction material, wet passages and scarce supplies; its route geometry can loop or mislead.

difficulty.rationale: The verified current page exposes major heat, navigation and hostile-entity hazards but no reliable Threat Index header; rating 4 is provisional.

records.name: Euler’s Imagination
records.summary: A mathematics-themed sublevel associated with Level 2, combining the Forest of Math and an Auditorium where geometric and mathematical anomalies become physically significant. Conventional life is absent.

difficulty.rationale: No reliable current Threat Index was verified; rating 3 is a provisional gameplay value for physically significant mathematical anomalies and navigation uncertainty.

records.name: The Red Flood
records.summary: The current official Levels 0–8 list identifies this as Level 2.2, 'The Red Flood'. Detailed environmental and hazard claims are intentionally left unspecified here because this change only verified the current list entry.

difficulty.rationale: Only the current list entry was verified in this pass. Rating 3 is deliberately provisional and inherits the hazardous Level 2 baseline until the page's current Threat Index is verified.

records.name: satuЯation
records.summary: A special-constant sublevel listed between Levels 3 and 4. Available wiki references associate it with gas-station-like spaces and strong visual/fog or saturation anomalies; details are kept conservative because the English page was not fully verified in this pass.

difficulty.rationale: The English page and current Threat Index were not fully verified; rating 2 is provisional and intentionally conservative rather than inventing Wiki canon.

records.name: The Cacophony of Corrosion
records.summary: A dangerous abandoned underground complex of stone and boiler-like rooms with severe temperature variation, corroded industrial infrastructure, alarms and periods of environmental shifting.

difficulty.rationale: Current Backrooms Fandom category classifies Level 3.53 as Class 5e - Environmental; gameplay maps it to rating 5.

records.name: The Cubicles
records.summary: An endless office of cubicles, hallways and meeting areas with unusual humidity, mold and vegetation. Food, drinks and Almond Water may exist, but deeper areas become more decrepit and entity activity rises.

difficulty.rationale: Current Backrooms Fandom page is categorized Class 2.

records.name: Intrusive Configuration
records.summary: A degraded office-like complex with a hostile, gore-heavy atmosphere and strong psychological or mind-influencing effects. It is treated as a dangerous intrusive configuration, not as evidence that parent Level 4 is generally unsafe.

difficulty.rationale: Current Threat Index is Class 4: exit 3/5, environment 5/5, entities 3/5.

records.name: Insubstantial Skywalks
records.summary: A labyrinth of warm connected skybridges meeting at unusual angles, with tan carpet, drywall, metal and glass. Structural instability and shifting fixture spacing make route confidence poor. The wiki page is currently being rewritten.

difficulty.rationale: No reliable current Threat Index was exposed while the page is under rewrite; rating 4 reflects fragile skybridges, abyss falls and difficult egress.

records.name: Summer Resort
records.summary: A comparatively habitable hotel/resort-like offshoot of Level 5 whose wiki history includes established colonies. It preserves the hotel lineage while providing a less uniformly hostile environment than Terror Hotel proper.

difficulty.rationale: The current page did not expose a reliable Threat Index in this verification pass; rating 2 reflects its comparatively habitable baseline while retaining event and navigation hazards.

records.name: The Gilded Atrium
records.summary: A vast early-20th-century Art Deco hotel atrium with multiple floors, ornate golden elevators, a grand split staircase, dim brass lighting and persistent distant piano ambience; locked rooms and anomalous inhabitants complicate exploration.

difficulty.rationale: No reliable current Threat Index was exposed; rating 3 reflects anomalous inhabitants, locked routes and a large difficult-to-survey hotel layout.

records.name: Can’t Stop Watching
records.summary: A warehouse of weak temporary walls, concrete monoliths, barriers and graffiti. Porcelain eye motifs called Wretched Watchers induce paranoia and watched sensations, while isolation and unusual safe rooms shape traversal.

difficulty.rationale: Current Survivability Index is Class 3: exit 3/5, environment 4/5, entities 2/5.

records.name: Silva Subterraneus
records.summary: A subterranean expanse of hanging roots and dead boreal trees under profound darkness, broken by faint skylight, lanterns and lamp posts. Petrified statues and severe psychological deterioration are central hazards.

difficulty.rationale: No current Threat Index was exposed; rating 4 reflects profound darkness, psychological deterioration and the petrification outcome documented by the page.

records.name: Eyes On The Road
records.summary: A sprawling aspen forest in perpetual dusk with eye-like formations on trees, unstable ground and pitfalls, severe perceptual pressure and a temporal anomaly reported at roughly 6.2 times slower than ordinary Backrooms time.

difficulty.rationale: The page is categorized Class Undetermined and explicitly describes the sublevel as among the most dangerous of the Main Nine; gameplay maps that uncertainty and hazard load to rating 5.

records.name: Amaxophobia
records.summary: A vehicle-choked city-and-forest sublevel associated with Level 6, with cold conditions and long linear routes obstructed by cars and road infrastructure. Conventional entity presence is not a defining feature in the verified reference.

difficulty.rationale: The current page's classification form marks Class U; gameplay maps the non-standard undetermined class to rating 4 because navigation and environmental information remain incomplete.

records.name: Blinding Lights
records.summary: An intensely bright anomalous region whose broad-spectrum radiation and warping materials make navigation and survival dangerous. Rare dim safe rooms can provide temporary relief from the otherwise overwhelming light.

difficulty.rationale: Current page is categorized Class Variable; gameplay maps it to rating 5 because broad-spectrum radiation, material warping and severe disorientation can become immediately lethal.

records.name: Cryophobia
records.summary: An abandoned basement-like sublevel of small rooms and long narrow corridors under extreme cold, with weak lamps acting as the only meaningful heat sources. Its apparent voices are documented as hallucinations rather than confirmed entities.

difficulty.rationale: Current Backrooms Fandom category classifies Level 6.66 as Class 5e - Environmental; gameplay maps it to rating 5.

records.name: Umbral Light
records.summary: An endless dead natural expanse of black grass, dead evergreens, stagnant water and scattered derelict structures. Matter fails to reflect emitted light, leaving the landscape effectively dark despite visible light sources and sky.

difficulty.rationale: Current Threat Index is Class Undetermined with exit 4/5 and environment 3/5; gameplay maps the severe darkness, cold and uncertain entity state to rating 4.
